errors.evidence: The description includes context from the paper's caption (e.g., "on the validation set", "using the Conformer + GPT2 language model as an example", "hyperparameter λ") which is not present in the image itself. The figure does not provide this experimental context.
The x-axis in the figure is not labeled. Stating that it represents the values of "λ" is an interpretation based on external information (the caption), not the visual content of the chart.
The description repeatedly uses the variable "λ" to refer to the x-axis values (e.g., "λ=0", "λ=0.1", etc.). This variable is not mentioned or defined anywhere in the figure.
The description locates the peak using the variable "λ". This information is not present in the figure and is inferred from external text.
